description: Calls a celestial down at great MP cost.
message1: %1 calls something down from on high!
name: ConvokeCelestial

description: Starts an automaton that runs on money.
message1: %1 starts an automaton running on coin!
name: ConvokeAutomaton

description: Fields a war machine at a ruinous hourly rate.
name: ConvokeWarMachine

description:
Sends the party's pet, or whatever the wild
sends.
name: ConvokeMenagerie

description:
Calls vermin that feed on the user while they
work.
message1: %1 calls vermin that feed while they work!
name: ConvokeSwarm

description:
Calls something up out of the water while MP
holds.
message1: %1 calls something up out of the water!
name: ConvokeTide

description: Calls something winged down onto the line.
message1: %1 calls something winged down to the line!
name: ConvokeWing

description: Uncoils a cold-blooded ally beside the party.
name: ConvokeSerpent

description: Roots a growing thing on the field for free.
message1: %1 roots a growing thing on the field!
name: ConvokeVerdure

description: Strikes a bargain with the small folk.
message1: %1 strikes a bargain with the small folk!
name: ConvokeFae

description: Calls a shade, held up by burning SOUL shares.
message1: %1 holds a shade up on burning SOUL!
name: ConvokeShade

description: Resolves the shadows into something with teeth.
message1: %1 lets the shadows resolve into teeth!
name: ConvokeUmbra

description:
Holds a way open for something outside, at great
cost.
message1: %1 holds a way open to the outside!
name: ConvokeVoid

description:
Buys a wyrm's attention, with tribute every
turn.
name: ConvokeWyrm

description: Wakes something enormous that leans on the user.
name: ConvokeTitan

description: Hires an armed champion by the turn.
name: ConvokeChampion

description: Buys the help of whatever is loitering nearby.
message1: %1 buys the help of the nearest rabble!
name: ConvokeRabble

description:
Calls something that eats money and keeps
eating.
name: ConvokeMimic

description: Burns the party's OIL to hold a petrodemon.
message1: %1 burns OIL to hold a petrodemon!
name: ConvokePetrodemon

description:
Calls something very old that drinks the user
dry.
message1: %1 asks something very old to attend!
name: ConvokeElder

description: Calls the creature the party marked.
name: ConvokeMarked

description:
Calls back the last thing the party killed, in
blood.
message1: %1 calls back the last thing the party killed!
name: ConvokeSlain

description:
Calls a marked person to the field for a few
turns.
message1: %1 calls a marked witness to the field!
name: ConvokeWitness

description: Calls a lesser copy of the user, paid for in AP.
message1: %1 pays out a lesser copy of themselves!
name: ConvokeReflection

description: Calls back a traveller the party has lost.
name: ConvokeRevenant

description: Marks a creature so a later rite can find it.
name: MarkQuarry

description: Marks the person ahead so a rite can call them.
name: MarkWitness

description:
Sends away whatever the party holds on the
field.
name: DismissSummon

description:
Wears a companion's name, class, skills and body
until the fight ends.
name: Borrowed Face

description:
Merges two creature bodies at random into the
user's own. The new body is permanent.
name: CrookedGrowth

description:
Throws the last move an enemy used straight back
at the enemy that used it.
name: Answer in Kind
